content.short: dApprovals is a centralized, secure way to manage your transaction approvals.
content.description: dApprovals centralizes the management of your transaction approvals in a single secure interface, reducing complexity and risk. Developed by a leading crypto security team focused on DeFi, it integrates an active risk mitigation system with a powerful firewall to guard against DeFi attacks, giving you stronger protection and clearer control when authorizing on-chain transactions across Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Avalanche, OP Mainnet, Solana and Bitcoin networks.
